description: Minister of Labour - industrial Dispute between Mr. I.A.D. Priyantna and National Water Supply and Drainage Board.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of legal/regulatory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically appointing an arbitrator to resolve an industrial dispute. It contains a statutory order issued by the Minister of Labour under specific legislative authority, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
